summary_en: 190,000 shares (2.02% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥300M ceiling. Execution June 15, 2026 to January 29, 2027 via open-market (ToSTNeT-3). Stated rationale: capital efficiency, shareholder returns, employee equity awards, M&A readiness, and responsive capital-allocation execution.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to treasury stock acquisition (acquisition of treasury shares pursuant to Company Code Article 165, Paragraph 2 and the Articles of Incorporation Article 7)
translation_en_brief:
INTLOOP Inc. announced on June 12, 2026 that its board has authorized acquisition of up to 190,000 treasury shares (representing 2.02% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, which totalled 9,414,540 shares as of May 31, 2026) at a total cost not to exceed ¥300 million. Execution will occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (ToSTNeT-3) during the window from June 15, 2026 through January 29, 2027.

The company cited multiple rationales for the program: improving capital efficiency and lifting shareholder value, commencing and expanding shareholder returns while maintaining aggressive growth investment, funding employee stock-incentive schemes, positioning for future M&A and other corporate actions, and enabling agile capital-allocation execution. Management acknowledged that the current stock price may not fully reflect the company's intrinsic value, which it identified as an important challenge. The buyback is intended to work in parallel with ongoing investment in human capital, margin improvement through high-profitability business focus, and AI-centric operational transformation initiatives launched under the VISION2030 medium-to-long-term plan.
